articles.title_en: The term structure of macroeconomic risks at the effective lower bound
articles.title_cn: 有效下限宏观经济风险期限结构
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new macro-finance model that solves the tension between tractability, flexibility in macroeconomic dynamics, and consistency of the term structures of treasury yields with the effective lower bound (ELB). I use the term structures of U.S. nominal and real treasury yields from 1990 to explore the interdependence between inflation expectations, volatility, and monetary policy at the ELB. The estimation reveals that real yields stay elevated during the ELB due to large premia and deflation fears, produced by a persistent shift in inflation dynamics, with low average inflation and heightened inflation volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的宏观金融模型，该模型解决了宏观经济动态的可处理性、灵活性以及国债收益率期限结构与有效下限（ELB）的一致性之间的紧张关系。我使用1990中的美国名义和实际国债收益率的期限结构来探讨通胀预期、波动性和 ELB 货币政策之间的相互依赖性。估计显示，由于通货膨胀动态的持续变化、平均通货膨胀率较低和通货膨胀波动性加大，导致溢价和通货紧缩担忧加剧，实际收益率在ELB期间保持较高水平。

articles.title_en: When uncertainty and volatility are disconnected: Implications for asset pricing and portfolio performance
articles.title_cn: 当不确定性与波动性脱节时：对资产定价和投资组合绩效的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze an environment where the uncertainty in the equity market return and its volatility are both stochastic and may be potentially disconnected. We solve a representative investor’s optimal asset allocation and derive the resulting conditional equity premium and risk-free rate in equilibrium. Our empirical analysis shows that the equity premium appears to be earned for facing uncertainty, especially high uncertainty that is disconnected from lower volatility, rather than for facing volatility as traditionally assumed. Incorporating the possibility of a disconnect between volatility and uncertainty significantly improves portfolio performance, over and above the performance obtained by conditioning on volatility only.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个股票市场回报的不确定性及其波动性均为随机且可能脱节的环境。我们求解了代表性投资者的最优资产配置，并推导出均衡状态下的条件股权溢价和无风险利率。我们的实证分析表明，股权溢价似乎是对面临不确定性，特别是与较低波动性脱节的高不确定性所获得的补偿，而非传统假设的面对波动性。将波动性与不确定性之间可能脱节的可能性纳入考虑，显著改善了投资组合绩效，其改善程度超过了仅以波动性为条件的绩效。

articles.title_cn: 正态混合的得分型检验
articles.abstract_en: Testing normality against discrete normal mixtures is complex because some parameters turn increasingly underidentified along alternative ways of approaching the null, others are inequality constrained, and several higher-order derivatives become identically 0. These problems make the maximum of the alternative model log-likelihood function numerically unreliable. We propose score-type tests asymptotically equivalent to the likelihood ratio as the largest of two simple intuitive statistics that only require estimation under the null. One novelty of our approach is that we treat symmetrically both ways of writing the null hypothesis without excluding any region of the parameter space. We derive the asymptotic distribution of our tests under the null and sequences of local alternatives. We also show that their asymptotic distribution is the same whether applied to observations or standardized residuals from heteroskedastic regression models. Finally, we study their power in simulations and apply them to the residuals of Mincer earnings functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对离散正态混合进行正态性检验是复杂的，因为某些参数在接近零假设的不同途径下变得越来越不可识别，其他参数受到不等式约束，并且若干高阶导数恒等于0。这些问题使得备择模型对数似然函数的最大化在数值上不可靠。我们提出了得分型检验，其渐近等价于似然比，作为两个简单直观统计量中的最大值，这些统计量仅需在零假设下进行估计。我们方法的一个新颖之处在于，我们对称地处理零假设的两种表述方式，而不排除参数空间的任何区域。我们推导了在零假设和局部备择序列下检验的渐近分布。我们还表明，无论应用于观测值还是来自异方差回归模型的标准残差，其渐近分布都是相同的。最后，我们通过模拟研究其功效，并将其应用于明瑟收入函数的残差。

articles.title_en: Efficiency bounds for moment condition models with mixed identification strength
articles.title_cn: 混合识别强度矩条件模型的效率界
articles.abstract_en: Moment condition models with mixed identification strength are models that are point identified but with estimating moment functions that are allowed to drift to 0 uniformly over the parameter space. Even though identification fails in the limit, depending on how slow the moment functions vanish, consistent estimation is possible. Existing estimators such as the generalized method of moment (GMM) estimator exhibit a pattern of nonstandard or even heterogeneous rate of convergence that materializes by some parameter directions being estimated at a slower rate than others. This paper derives asymptotic semiparametric efficiency bounds for regular estimators of parameters of these models. We show that GMM estimators are regular and that the so-called two-step GMM estimator – using the inverse of estimating function’s variance as weighting matrix – is semiparametrically efficient as it reaches the minimum variance attainable by regular estimators. This estimator is also asymptotically minimax efficient with respect to a large family of loss functions. Monte Carlo simulations are provided that confirm these results.
articles.abstract_cn: 混合识别强度的矩条件模型是点识别的模型，但其估计矩函数允许在参数空间上均匀地趋近于0。尽管在极限情况下识别失败，但根据矩函数消失的速度，一致估计仍是可能的。现有估计器如广义矩方法（GMM）估计器表现出非标准甚至异质收敛速度的模式，这体现在某些参数方向以较慢的速度被估计。本文推导了这些模型参数的正则估计器的渐近半参数效率界。我们表明GMM估计器是正则的，并且所谓的两步GMM估计器——使用估计函数方差的逆作为权重矩阵——是半参数有效的，因为它达到了正则估计器可达到的最小方差。该估计器对于一大类损失函数也是渐近极小极大有效的。提供了蒙特卡洛模拟以确认这些结果。

articles.title_en: Identification robust inference for the risk premium in term structure models
articles.title_cn: 期限结构模型中风险溢价的识别稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose identification robust statistics for testing hypotheses on the risk premia in dynamic affine term structure models. We do so using the moment equation specification proposed in Adrian et al. (2013). Statistical inference based on their three-stage estimator requires knowledge of the risk factors’ quality and can be misleading when the β’s are weak, which results when sampling errors are of comparable order of magnitude as the risk factor loadings. We extend the subset (factor) Anderson–Rubin test from Guggenberger et al. (2012) to models with multiple dynamic factors and time-varying risk prices. It provides a computationally tractable manner to conduct identification robust tests on a few risk premia when a larger number is present. We use it to analyze potential identification issues arising in the data from Adrian et al. (2013) for which we show that some factors, though potentially weak, may drive the time variation of risk prices, and weak identification issues are more prominent in multi-factor models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了用于检验动态仿射期限结构模型中风险溢价假设的识别稳健统计量。我们采用Adrian等人（2013）提出的矩方程规范来实现这一目标。基于其三阶段估计量的统计推断需要了解风险因素的质量，并且当β较弱时可能会产生误导，这发生在抽样误差与风险因素载荷量级相当的情况下。我们将Guggenberger等人（2012）的子集（因子）Anderson–Rubin检验扩展到具有多个动态因子和时变风险价格的情形。它提供了一种计算上可行的方法，在存在较多风险溢价时对少数风险溢价进行识别稳健检验。我们用它来分析Adrian等人（2013）数据中可能出现的识别问题，并表明某些因子虽然可能较弱，但可能驱动风险价格的时变，且弱识别问题在多因子模型中更为突出。

articles.title_cn: 跨越潜在因子与可观测因子
articles.abstract_en: Factor analysis is a widely used tool to summarize high dimensional panel data via a small dimensional set of latent factors. Many applications in finance and macroeconomics, are often focused on observable factors with an economic interpretation. The objective of this paper is to provide a test to answer a question which naturally comes up in discussions regarding latent versus observable factors: do latent and observable factors span the same space? We derive asymptotic properties of a formal test and propose a bootstrap version with improved small sample properties. We find empirical evidence for a small number of factors common between a small number of traditional Fama–French risk factors – or returns on a few stocks (i.e. “magnificent” 5 or 7) – and large panels of US, North American and international portfolio returns.
articles.abstract_cn: 因子分析是一种广泛使用的工具，通过少量潜在因子来概括高维面板数据。金融和宏观经济学中的许多应用通常关注具有经济解释的可观测因子。本文旨在提供一个检验，以回答在讨论潜在因子与可观测因子时自然出现的问题：潜在因子与可观测因子是否跨越同一空间？我们推导了一个正式检验的渐近性质，并提出了一种具有改进小样本性质的bootstrap版本。我们发现了经验证据表明，少数传统Fama–French风险因子——或少数股票的回报（即“ magnificent” 5 或 7）——与大型美国、北美和国际投资组合回报面板之间存在少量共同因子。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the identification, estimation, and inference of long-term (binary) treatment effect parameters when balanced panel data is not available, or consists of only a subset of the available data. We develop a new estimator: the chained difference-in-differences, which leverages the overlapping structure of many unbalanced panel data sets. This approach consists in aggregating a collection of short-term treatment effects estimated on multiple incomplete panels. Our estimator accommodates (1) multiple time periods, (2) variation in treatment timing, (3) treatment effect heterogeneity, (4) general missing data patterns, and (5) sample selection on observables. We establish the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimator and discuss identification and efficiency gains in comparison to existing methods. Finally, we illustrate its relevance through (i) numerical simulations, and (ii) an application about the effects of an innovation policy in France.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在平衡面板数据不可用或仅包含可用数据子集时，长期（二元）处理效应参数的识别、估计和推断问题。我们开发了一种新的估计量：链式双重差分法，它利用了众多非平衡面板数据集的重叠结构。该方法包括聚合在多个不完整面板上估计的一系列短期处理效应。我们的估计量适用于（1）多个时间段，（2）处理时点的变化，（3）处理效应异质性，（4）一般缺失数据模式，以及（5）基于可观测变量的样本选择。我们建立了所提出估计量的渐近性质，并讨论了与现有方法相比的识别和效率提升。最后，我们通过（i）数值模拟和（ii）关于法国创新政策效应的应用来说明其相关性。

articles.title_en: Exogeneity tests and weak identification in IV regressions: Asymptotic theory and point estimation
articles.title_cn: IV回归中的外生性检验与弱识别：渐近理论与点估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new insights on exogeneity tests in linear IV models and their use for estimation, when identification fails or may not be strong. We make two main contributions. First, we show that Durbin–Wu–Hausman (DWH) and Revankar–Hartley (RH) exogeneity tests have correct level asymptotically, even when the first-stage coefficient matrix (which controls identification) is rank-deficient. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which these tests are consistent. In particular, we show that test consistency can hold even when identification fails, provided at least one component of the structural parameter vector is identifiable. Second, we study point estimation after estimator (or model) selection, when the outcome of a DWH/RH test determines whether OLS or an IV method is employed in the second-stage. For this purpose, we use (non-local) concepts of asymptotic bias, asymptotic mean squared error (AMSE), and asymptotic relative efficiency (ARE), which remain applicable even when the estimators considered do not have moments (as can happen for 2SLS) or may be inconsistent. We study the asymptotic properties of OLS, 2SLS, and pretest estimators which select OLS or 2SLS based on the outcome of a DWH/RH test. We show that: (i) OLS typically dominates 2SLS estimator asymptotically for MSE across a broad spectrum of cases, including weak identification and moderate endogeneity; (ii) exogeneity-pretest estimators exhibit consistently good performance and asymptotically dominate both OLS and 2SLS. The proposed theoretical findings are documented by Monte Carlo simulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为线性IV模型中的外生性检验及其在识别失败或可能不强时的估计使用提供了新的见解。我们做出两大贡献。首先，我们证明即使第一阶段系数矩阵（控制识别）秩亏，Durbin–Wu–Hausman (DWH) 和 Revankar–Hartley (RH) 外生性检验在渐近意义上仍具有正确的水平。我们提供了这些检验一致性的充分必要条件。特别地，我们表明，即使识别失败，只要结构参数向量中至少有一个分量是可识别的，检验的一致性仍可成立。其次，我们研究了在估计量（或模型）选择后的点估计，此时DWH/RH检验的结果决定第二阶段是采用OLS还是IV方法。为此，我们使用（非局部的）渐近偏差、渐近均方误差（AMSE）和渐近相对效率（ARE）概念，这些概念即使在所考虑的估计量没有矩（如2SLS可能发生的情况）或可能不一致的情况下仍然适用。我们研究了OLS、2SLS以及基于DWH/RH检验结果选择OLS或2SLS的预检验估计量的渐近性质。我们表明：(i) 在广泛的案例中，包括弱识别和中等内生性，OLS在MSE方面通常在渐近意义上优于2SLS估计量；(ii) 外生性预检验估计量表现出持续良好的性能，并在渐近意义上优于OLS和2SLS。所提出的理论发现通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到了验证。

articles.abstract_en: We model predictive scale-specific cycles. By employing suitable matrix representations, we express the forecast errors of covariance-stationary multivariate time series in terms of conditionally orthonormal scale-specific bases. The representations yield conditionally orthogonal decompositions of these forecast errors. They also provide decompositions of their variances and betas in terms of scale-specific variances and betas capturing predictive variability and co-variability over cycles of alternative lengths without spillovers across cycles. Making use of the proposed representations within the classical family of time-varying conditional volatility models, we document the role of time-varying volatility forecasts in generating orthogonal predictive scale-specific cycles in returns. We conclude by providing suggestive evidence that the conditional variances of the predictive return cycles (i) may be priced over short-to-medium horizons and (ii) may offer economically-relevant trading signals over these same horizons.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们建模预测性的尺度特定周期。通过采用适当的矩阵表示，我们将协方差平稳多元时间序列的预测误差表达为条件正交的尺度特定基。这些表示产生了这些预测误差的条件正交分解。它们还提供了其方差和贝塔的分解，以尺度特定的方差和贝塔形式，捕捉不同长度周期上的预测变异性和协变性，而不会在周期之间产生溢出效应。在经典时变条件波动率模型族中利用所提出的表示，我们记录了时变波动率预测在生成收益的条件正交预测尺度特定周期中的作用。最后，我们提供初步证据表明，预测收益周期的条件方差（i）可能在短至中期内被定价，并且（ii）可能在这些相同的时间范围内提供经济相关的交易信号。

articles.title_en: Weak identification in discrete choice models
articles.title_cn: 离散选择模型中的弱识别
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of weak identification in discrete choice models, and provide insights into the determinants of identification strength in these models. Using these insights, we propose a novel test that can consistently detect weak identification in commonly applied discrete choice models, such as probit, logit, and many of their extensions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that when the null hypothesis of weak identification is rejected, Wald-based inference can be carried out using standard formulas and critical values. A Monte Carlo study compares our proposed testing approach against commonly applied weak identification tests. The results simultaneously demonstrate the good performance of our approach and the fundamental failure of using conventional weak identification tests for linear models in the discrete choice model context. Lastly, we apply our approach in two empirical examples: married women labor force participation, and US food aid and civil conflicts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了离散选择模型中弱识别的影响，并提供了关于这些模型中识别强度决定因素的见解。利用这些见解，我们提出了一种新颖的检验方法，能够一致地检测常用离散选择模型（如probit、logit及其许多扩展）中的弱识别。此外，我们证明当弱识别的零假设被拒绝时，基于Wald的推断可以使用标准公式和临界值进行。一项蒙特卡洛研究将我们提出的检验方法与常用的弱识别检验进行了比较。结果同时展示了我们方法的良好性能，以及在线性模型背景下使用传统弱识别检验在离散选择模型情境中的根本性失败。最后，我们将我们的方法应用于两个实证例子：已婚女性劳动力参与，以及美国食品援助与国内冲突。

articles.title_en: Uncovering asset market participation from household consumption and income
articles.title_cn: 从家庭消费与收入中揭示资产市场参与
articles.abstract_en: We propose an asset pricing model featuring time-varying limited participation in both bond and stock markets and household heterogeneity. Households participate in financial markets with a certain probability that depends on their individual income and on asset market conditions. We use indirect inference to uncover individual asset market participation from individual consumption data and asset prices. Our model very accurately reproduces the proportions of stockholders in the Survey of Consumer Finances over three-year intervals, provides a reasonable estimate of stock market participation costs, and is able to price characteristic-based stock portfolios with the top decile of households identified as stockholders.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个资产定价模型，该模型具有时变的有限参与特征，涉及债券市场和股票市场，并包含家庭异质性。家庭以一定的概率参与金融市场，这一概率取决于其个人收入和资产市场状况。我们使用间接推断方法，从个人消费数据和资产价格中揭示个人资产市场参与情况。我们的模型非常准确地再现了消费者金融调查中三年间隔内的股东比例，提供了对股票市场参与成本的合理估计，并能够对基于特征构建的股票投资组合进行定价，其中将家庭收入最高的十分位识别为股东。

articles.title_en: Long-run risk in stationary vector autoregressive models
articles.title_cn: 平稳向量自回归模型中的长期风险
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a local-to-unity/small sigma model for stationary processes with long-range persistence and non-negligible long-run prediction and estimation risks. The model represents a process containing unobserved short and long-run components measured on different time scales. The short-run component is defined in calendar time, while the long-run component evolves in rescaled time with ultra-long units. We develop estimation and long-run prediction methods for time series with multivariate Vector Autoregressive (VAR) short-run components and reveal the impossibility of estimating consistently some of the long-run parameters, which causes significant estimation and prediction risks in the long run. A simulation study and an application to macroeconomic data illustrate the approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一个局部单位根/小西格玛模型，用于处理具有长期持续性和不可忽视的长期预测与估计风险的平稳过程。该模型表示一个包含在不同时间尺度上测量的未观测短期和长期成分的过程。短期成分以日历时间定义，而长期成分则以重新缩放的时间（具有超长单位）演化。我们为具有多元向量自回归（VAR）短期成分的时间序列开发了估计和长期预测方法，并揭示了无法一致估计某些长期参数的可能性，这导致了长期中显著的估计和预测风险。一项模拟研究和对宏观经济数据的应用说明了该方法。

articles.title_en: Identification-robust and simultaneous inference in multifactor asset pricing models
articles.title_cn: 多因子资产定价模型中的识别稳健与联合推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes exact identification-robust confidence sets for the zero-beta rate and ex-post factor prices in asset pricing models. Exploiting the information from the cross-sectional intercept allows us to impose or formally test model-consistent restrictions, including those resulting from traded factors in excess of the zero beta-rate or from return spreads. Analytical projection-based solutions for confidence set outcomes are developed. The proposed procedures are extended to the case of missing factors. Empirical and simulation results with traded and non-traded factors show that model-consistent restrictions and elusive factors can materially affect model fit, identification, inference and temporal constancy of pricing influence.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了资产定价模型中零贝塔率和事后因子价格的精确识别稳健置信集。利用横截面截距的信息，我们可以施加或正式检验模型一致性约束，包括那些由超过零贝塔率的交易因子或收益价差产生的约束。开发了基于投影的置信集结果的解析解。所提出的程序被扩展到因子缺失的情形。实证和模拟结果（包含交易和非交易因子）表明，模型一致性约束和难以捉摸的因子可能实质性影响模型拟合、识别、推断以及定价影响的时点恒定性。

articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the problem of ecological inference when one observes the conditional distributions of Y|W and Z|W from aggregate data and attempts to infer the conditional distribution of Y|Z without observing Y and Z in the same sample. First, we show that this problem can be transformed into a linear equation involving operators for which, under suitable regularity assumptions, least squares solutions are available. We then propose the use of the least squares solution with the minimum Hilbert–Schmidt norm, which, in our context, can be structurally interpreted as the solution with minimum dependence between Y and Z. Interestingly, in the case where the conditioning variable W is discrete and belongs to a finite set, such as the labels of units/groups/cities, the solution of this minimal dependence has a closed form. In the more general case, we use a regularization scheme and show the convergence of our proposed estimator. A numerical evaluation of our procedure is proposed.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑生态推断问题，即从聚合数据中观察 Y|W 和 Z|W 的条件分布，并尝试在不观察同一样本中的 Y 和 Z 的情况下推断 Y|Z 的条件分布。首先，我们证明这个问题可以转化为涉及算子的线性方程，在适当的正则性假设下，可以使用最小二乘解。然后，我们建议使用具有最小希尔伯特-施密特范数的最小二乘解，在我们的上下文中，它可以在结构上解释为 Y 和 Z 之间依赖性最小的解。有趣的是，在条件变量 W 是离散的并且属于有限集的情况下，例如单位/组/城市的标签，这种最小依赖性的解具有封闭形式。在更一般的情况下，我们使用正则化方案并显示我们提出的估计器的收敛性。建议对我们的程序进行数值评估。

articles.abstract_en: I adapt the Generalised Method of Moments to deal with nonlinear models in which a finite number of isolated parameter values satisfy the moment conditions. I also study the closely related class of first-order underidentified models, whose expected Jacobian is rank deficient but not necessarily zero. In both cases, my proposed procedures exploit the underidentification structure to yield parameter estimators and underidentification tests within a standard asymptotically normal GMM framework. I study nonlinear models with and without separation of data and parameters. I also illustrate my proposed inference procedures with applications to production function estimation and dynamic panel data models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我将广义矩方法加以调整，以处理在非线性模型中仅有有限个孤立的参数值满足矩条件的情况。我还研究了与之密切相关的一阶欠识别模型类别，其期望雅可比矩阵秩亏但未必为零。在这两种情形下，我所提出的程序利用欠识别结构，在标准渐近正态GMM框架内得到参数估计量和欠识别检验。我研究了数据和参数分离及不分离的非线性模型。我还通过生产函数估计和动态面板数据模型的应用，展示了所提出的推断程序。

articles.title_en: Regularizing stock return covariance matrices via multiple testing of correlations
articles.title_cn: 通过相关性多重检验对股票收益协方差矩阵进行正则化
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a large-scale inference approach for the regularization of stock return covariance matrices. The framework allows for the presence of heavy tails and multivariate GARCH-type effects of unknown form among the stock returns. The approach involves simultaneous testing of all pairwise correlations, followed by setting non-statistically significant elements to zero. This adaptive thresholding is achieved through sign-based Monte Carlo resampling within multiple testing procedures, controlling either the traditional familywise error rate, a generalized familywise error rate, or the false discovery proportion. Subsequent shrinkage ensures that the final covariance matrix estimate is positive definite and well-conditioned while preserving the achieved sparsity. Compared to alternative estimators, this new regularization method demonstrates strong performance in simulation experiments and real portfolio optimization.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种用于股票收益协方差矩阵正则化的大规模推断方法。该框架允许股票收益中存在重尾和形式未知的多元GARCH效应。该方法涉及对所有两两相关性进行同时检验，然后将统计上不显著的元素设为零。这种自适应阈值化通过符号基础的蒙特卡洛重抽样在多重检验程序中实现，控制传统的族系错误率、广义族系错误率或错误发现比例。随后的收缩确保最终协方差矩阵估计是正定的且条件良好，同时保持所实现的稀疏性。与替代估计器相比，这种新的正则化方法在模拟实验和实际投资组合优化中表现出强大的性能。

articles.title_en: Simulation-based estimation with many auxiliary statistics applied to long-run dynamic analysis
articles.title_cn: 基于模拟的估计与大量辅助统计量在长期动态分析中的应用
articles.abstract_en: The existing asymptotic theory for estimators obtained by simulated minimum distance does not cover situations in which the number of components of the auxiliary statistics (or number of matched “moments”) is large — typically larger than the sample size. We establish the consistency of the simulated minimum distance estimator in this situation and derive its asymptotic distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有的针对模拟最小距离估计量的渐近理论并未涵盖辅助统计量分量（或匹配的“矩”数量）较多——通常大于样本量——的情形。我们在此情形下建立了模拟最小距离估计量的一致性，并推导了其渐近分布。

articles.title_en: Identifying the volatility risk price through the leverage effect
articles.title_cn: 通过杠杆效应识别波动率风险价格
articles.abstract_en: In asset pricing models with stochastic volatility, uncertainty about volatility affects risk premia through two channels: aversion to decreasing returns and aversion to increasing volatility. We analyze the identification of and robust inference for structural parameters measuring investors’ aversions to these risks: the return risk price and the volatility risk price. In the presence of a leverage effect (instantaneous causality between the asset return and its volatility), we study the identification of both structural parameters with the price data only, without relying on additional option pricing models or option data. We analyze this identification challenge in a nonparametric discrete-time exponentially affine model, complementing the continuous-time approach of Bandi and Renò (2016). We then specialize to a parametric model and derive the implied minimum distance criterion relating the risk prices to the asset return and volatility’s joint distribution. This criterion is almost flat when the leverage effect is small, and we introduce identification-robust confidence sets for both risk prices regardless of the magnitude of the leverage effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有随机波动率的资产定价模型中，波动率的不确定性通过两个渠道影响风险溢价：对收益下降的厌恶和对波动率上升的厌恶。我们分析了衡量投资者对这些风险厌恶程度的结构参数的识别和稳健推断：收益风险价格和波动率风险价格。在存在杠杆效应（资产收益与其波动率之间的瞬时因果关系）的情况下，我们仅使用价格数据研究这两个结构参数的识别，而不依赖额外的期权定价模型或期权数据。我们在非参数离散时间指数仿射模型中分析这一识别挑战，补充了Bandi和Renò（2016）的连续时间方法。然后我们专门研究参数模型，并推导出将风险价格与资产收益和波动率联合分布联系起来的最小距离准则。当杠杆效应较小时，该准则几乎是平坦的，我们引入了对两个风险价格的识别稳健置信集，无论杠杆效应的幅度如何。
